ShortDescription.Value: Unlock Signature buildings, place multiple Unique buildings, and control city-wide and nearby bonuses.

Publish.LongDescription:
# 🏙️ ### Realistic Signature Buildings Fix #### Place unlimited buildings without breaking the city's economy!
独特建筑 / 标志性建筑不限数量！想建多少就建多少，还能控制建筑加成，避免城市经济失衡！
🇨🇳 完整中文介绍请往下看 ↓
CS2 does not anticipate many copies of the same Unique buildings so powerful city-wide bonuses quickly multiply and make the game very easy. Now you can build unlimited copies of Unique buildings, keep vanilla bonuses as-is or reduce unrealistic stacking.
### 1. Control Unique + Signature city-wide bonuses
* **Vanilla Stacking:** every copy has all normal bonuses (game default). Want super-easy mode? Keep stacking! * **First Copy Only**: only one copy of each Unique or Signature building type adds city-wide bonuses (where available). More Realistic, 5 copies no longer has 5x stacked bonuses! * **No City Bonuses:** disable general city-wide bonuses from Unique and Signature buildings.
**Control City-wide Attractiveness** for eligible Unique and Signature buildings: choose First copy only (default), Vanilla stacking, No bonus, or Follow city-wide setting.
### 2. Control Nearby local effects for Unique Buildings
* Keep neighborhood "aoe" benefits while limiting city-wide bonus stacking. * Choose Vanilla, First-Copy Only, or Off (independent of city-wide bonuses).
### 3. Allow Unlimited Unique buildings - You choose!
* ✅ Unlock Signature buildings without meeting their requirements. Other Unique service buildings still need Development points like City Hall. * ✅ QoL, Hide mass unlock pop-ups: Stop the spam when unlocking many at once. Save your click finger! * ✅ See Buildings Clearly: prevent blacked-out buildings and colored overlays while placing Unique buildings. You can still open the infoview panel manually or turn off this Option (player request - vanilla's blacked-out buildings are harder to see for placement).
### Compatibility
* Compatible with **Anarchy**, including its multiple unique setting. * Safe to remove: placed copies stay; vanilla bonuses and placement rules return after restart. No Harmony patches, vanilla methods.
### Important
* Hover over Options menu rows for tool tips (see the 3rd panel). * Note about a building's green bonus text: the info panel always shows the original bonus details, even when this mod reduces or disables those bonuses. This is only a display limitation — the actual bonuses are controlled correctly. Check Options → Actions → Status or use the About tab → Status report buttons to verify details.
## Support and Feedback
* Support by clicking Like (top right), no donations requested, just a like for many days of work. * For feedback, use the [Discord](https://discord.gg/gwXgvtyhjc) | [GitHub](https://github.com/River-Mochi/CS2-RealisticSignature) links on this page. PRs are welcome, GPL-3.0 license.
### Languages
English, Français, Deutsch, Español, Italiano, Polski, Português (Brasil), Português (Portugal), Türkçe, ไทย, Tiếng Việt, 日本語, 한국어, 简体中文, 繁體中文

## 独特建筑 / 标志性建筑不限数量！
**想建多少就建多少！默认开启，无需额外模组！**
- **✅ 无限建造：** 解除独特建筑和标志性建筑的重复建造限制。支持原版、DLC、地区建筑包及兼容的自定义资产。 - **✅ 全市加成：** 自由选择原版叠加、每种建筑仅计算一栋（默认），或完全关闭，避免经济失衡。 - **✅ 城市吸引力：** 独立控制吸引力加成，可保留原版效果或防止重复叠加。 - **✅ 周边效果：** 可选择原版效果（默认）、仅一栋生效或关闭。 - **✅ 解锁建筑：** 可选择跳过标志性建筑的解锁条件。其他独特公共服务建筑仍需发展点数。 - **✅ 界面优化：** 减少解锁弹窗，防止放置建筑时自动出现遮挡视线的信息覆盖层。
**兼容 Anarchy，无需 Harmony 补丁。** 移除模组不会删除已建造的建筑。
**注意：** 建筑信息面板的绿色加成文字仍显示原版数值，但模组实际加成控制正常生效。可在选项中的状态报告查看。
